title: Prism Match
theme: A colony of glowing crystal creatures in a deep cavern must be grouped by color to charge a beacon and open the way forward.
mechanics: Swap adjacent tiles to match three or more of the same color
Cleared tiles charge the beacon and new crystals fall into place
Reach the target charge before your moves run out
Progress through hand-authored levels with increasing targets

controls.key: Click or tap a crystal tile
Click or tap a neighboring tile
